hypothesis: A locally cached Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 4-bit policy, using VARE’s bounded tool-use loop, can inspect the MLX-LM #1910 baseline, make an allowlisted edit, run public feedback, revise if needed, and produce a candidate that the isolated independent grader accepts in at least one of two matched Development attempts.
matching: Both attempts use the same model, baseline tree, system/task prompt, tools, public test, turn/token/wall limits, and hidden grader budget. Each begins from a fresh copy; attempt outputs are paired within one task and are not independent task samples.
metrics: attempt-level independent success (0/2 to 2/2; attempts on one task are not independent)
unique Development tasks with at least one accepted attempt (0/1 or 1/1)
peak RSS and MLX active/peak Metal memory
failure taxonomy and raw per-turn outputs
